triggerCases.prompt: Implement this JavaScript authentication boundary using the repository's engineering standards.
Review this React component against our accessibility and design-system standards.
Write a concise pull-request description for these completed changes.
Continue where the previous coding session stopped.

outputCases.prompt: Review the proposed server-side JavaScript change using only the relevant engineering standards.
outputCases.expectedOutcome: A scoped review that applies coding and security guidance without loading unrelated UI, localization, or performance guidance.
assertions: The workflow applies the coding-principles and security references because the change handles an authorization boundary.
The workflow does not apply accessibility, design-system, internationalization, or performance guidance without a matching risk.
The repository's existing request-context convention takes precedence over a personal implementation preference.
The review remains read-only and does not infer commit or remote-write authority.
